title: Weekend meeting with Dick Cheney on why the Iraq war was being lost
summary: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells of Weekend meeting with Dick Cheney on why the Iraq war was being lost, about 2003 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I'm talking to the Vice President Dick Cheney who I got to know exceptionally well, also.

plain: A former CIA officer, Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, says that in 2003 he met one weekend at the White House with Dick Cheney, then the US Vice President, whom he says he got to know exceptionally well. He says the talk was about why the Iraq war was being lost, and he writes about his career in his book, A State of Mind: Faith in the CIA. He tells it to show how close he stood to the top of US power.
